host.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M
host.flags: -O2, portable C fallbacks (no PIE SIMD), pinned to one core with taskset

source.sim: sim/host_render.c lineage via u1/host_render_u1.c; scratch copy host_w28.c (not committed)
source.scene_copy: firmware/entities/RaBbLE/src/scene.c with env NL_OFFMASK switches added in the scratch copy only

method.statistic: median over 5 process runs of per-run means
method.frame_loop: steps nl_simulate at 1/60 s for 6 s (boot_early: 0.3 s); per-run mean over the last 120 frames (1 frame for boot fixtures)

fields.render_damaged_ms: only bands where nl_band_same()==0, as the device does
fields.dmg_bands_mean: bands changed versus the previous frame (of 30), mean over the measured frames
fields.repeat_same: the S353 repeat-frame line: bands unchanged when the same inputs are simulated again (of 30)

method.off_on: off = the effect removed (always-present effects) or not switched on (input-gated effects: ring.tint, ring.drain_arc, ui.slide, orbit); mesh.touch_dent compares a held touch with and without the dent; mesh.orbit_handoff compares the Orbit slide with and without handoff.
caveats: host ms is not device ms: x86 -O2 against LX7 240 MHz with PIE SIMD; prims and damaged bands are the portable proxies
sim ms is a single-digit-microsecond quantity; deltas under about 20 us are noise
activity input fixed at 0.3/0.6 (busy fixtures 1.0); the device derives it from CPU load
glass sprites are stand-in blocks (clock, status, hint, caption), not LVGL text
infinity is not built on any surface yet, so it is not measured; backdrop.void is a flat fill with no prims and no switch
speaking is not explained by any host proxy (see summary)

fixtures.boot_early: boot 0.3 (portals fading in; compared with boot done at the same time)
fixtures.orbit_slide: Orbit home page at slide 233 px, entity gathering into orbs (orbit_scenes.c home(), fan/snap/items 0.6; approximate, not a captured frame)
fixtures.turn_idle: idle with a steady roll of 0.8 rad/s

not_measured.backdrop.void: flat NL_BG fill, no prims, no switch
not_measured.all others: support none on pocket_hw: out of scope
